mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects ok=False, NON_ATTESTABLE_TILE; mutant authorized Tile 5

mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects commits=0; mutant committed 1
mutations.detection_details: Detected: memory commit permitted without tile authorization.

mutations.mutated_behavior: Delivered read response after in-flight revocation
mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects ok=False; mutant returned ok=True
mutations.detection_details: Detected: response not suppressed upon mid-read revocation.

mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects ok=False, OUT_OF_WINDOW_ADDRESS; mutant returned ok=True
mutations.detection_details: Detected: old 0x8 window accepted instead of being rejected with fault 13.

mutations.mutated_behavior: Permitted 4th BUSY retry without failing closed
mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects REVOKE_FAILED; mutant returned RETRY
mutations.detection_details: Detected: fourth BUSY did not fail closed.

mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects nonce equality; mutant changed nonce
mutations.detection_details: Detected: challenge identity was not preserved across retries.

mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects ok=False, status=5, fault=7; mutant returned ok=True

mutations.expected_detection: Targeted test expects sticky=True, count=1; mutant cleared to 0
mutations.detection_details: Detected: untrusted traffic was able to clear fault status.
